purpose: Read-only city-specific source discovery and bounded access review; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: Official Lagos State land-administration tools are statewide and do not document city-specific Ikorodu coverage. Ikorodu-specific LASBCA listings are building-control offices, not title registries. City-local registry and public parcel geometry are therefore left unconfirmed.

officialEvidence.observation: Statewide official land-administration portal; no Ikorodu-specific parcel dataset or public vector contract verified.
Surveyor-General transaction portal advertises land records, record-copy, verification, survey consent and charting services; no anonymous parcel layer verified.
Local Ikorodu district offices are building-control services and are not title/cadastre evidence.

routes: Official statewide land-admin portal describes address/property-number/parcel-ID search and GIS map, but no public anonymous feature-list route was documented.
Surveyor-General portal offers record copy, verification, survey-consent and charting transactions; its certificate-validation form requires a survey-plan number.
viewer.notes: No private property identifiers or user credentials were submitted; no geometry request was made.

serviceTrace.notes: Lagos statewide coverage cannot be used to infer geometry or registry dataset completeness at the Ikorodu WUP point.

geometryValidation.reason: No Ikorodu-specific anonymous geometry endpoint or safe feature schema was documented; no parcel feature query was made.
